notes: Requires a Gezel build with Iris defaults and stable-diffusion.cpp master-951-f89d9b1 or newer. Original F32 image weights are loaded in BF16; the Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct Q4_K_M text encoder keeps its quantization. Use CFG 3, Euler, diffusion flash attention, and dimensions divisible by 16 at approximately one megapixel. The publisher recommends 100 steps; Gezel renders 50, which matched 100 in the Gezel image bench at half the time. A 20-step 1024x1024 render took 174 seconds on a 128 GB Apple M5 Max, with about 11.8 GB peak resident memory. On a DGX Spark (GB10, CUDA) a 1024px render took about 150 seconds at 50 steps and 300 at 100, with a peak of 13 to 15 GiB of memory, so 16 GB machines are tight. Captions are limited to 300 tokens including the assistant-turn suffix. No VAE or vision projector is needed. Text-to-image only: depth estimation and restoration/upscaling require separate checkpoints and are not included.
